# EMT Associates

> EMT Associates provides comprehensive program evaluation, technical assistance, training, and research services across behavioral health, education, public health, and criminal justice sectors.

Based in California and Tennessee with offices in Folsom and Nashville, EMT Associates specializes in evidence-based evaluation methodologies, survey research, data analysis, and multimedia communications technology. The firm has extensive experience with federal agencies including NIH, CDC, and the U.S. Department of Education.

## Key Topics

- Program Evaluation
- Technical Assistance
- Training Services
- Survey Research
- Data Analysis
- Behavioral Health
- School Safety
- Public Health
- Criminal Justice
- Education Development
- Logic Models
- Drug Courts
- HIV Prevention
- Emergency Preparedness
- Consulting Services
